aesthetic: Terroir — a warm-parchment field where deep-growth greens and earth tones collide with ultra-light type, every slide a hand-pressed botanical specimen card composed under Weingart tension
chromaticArc: Slides 1–3 breathe on warm parchment with moss and ochre accents; slides 4–5 spike into Forest Dark (the two permitted dark section dividers); slides 6–10 return to raw linen with burnt sienna and golden ochre warmth, closing on full parchment with a single charcoal typographic anchor.
gridStrategy: Each slide occupies a different compositional mode cycling through: right-anchor (title col 32+), bottom-heavy (title row 28+), left-narrow body with breathing right field, full-bleed title, stacked vertical rhythm, and inverted body-above-title — no two adjacent slides share a zone arrangement.

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: Georgia on slides 3, 7, and 9 (reflective or narrative body content) and on any slide where title weight is 100 (ultra-light), pairing lightness with serif warmth; Courier New on data-dense or list slides (slides 5 and 8)

accentStrategy: Forest Dark or Burnt Sienna thick bars (rowSpan 2–3, span 4–8) anchor the left or centre gutter on 60%+ of slides, with Sage Haze colour blocks (type: block) used as breathing fields behind right-pushed titles on 3 slides, and single Golden Ochre dot elements serving as visual full-stops at unexpected grid corners.
